preregistration_statement: All numeric gates in this file were fixed before any candidate-scorer model call. Gain gates are stated relative to the already-frozen deterministic comparator baseline, which was computed from frozen artifacts only. No candidate-scorer output existed or was observed when these thresholds were written.

comparator.name: EVIDENCE_JUDGE_V1 deterministic adapter
comparator.baseline_derivation: Deterministic judge candidate labels crosswalked and compared with the fixture-derived oracle below; recomputed and asserted inside the evaluate phase.

oracle_extension.statement: Fixture oracles are stored at case level (expected_sufficiency). Candidate-level expected labels are derived by the deterministic category rules below, fixed as part of this preregistration.
oracle_extension.special_contradictory_rule: Candidate doc_id ending in -CONTRADICTORY expects CONTRADICTORY; the other candidate of the same case expects DIRECT_SUPPORT.
oracle_extension.special_unsupported_rule: If any of the keywords credential or persist (case-insensitive) appears in the candidate title joined with its behavior tags, expect PARTIAL; otherwise expect IRRELEVANT.
oracle_extension.bundle_label: The stored case-level fixture_oracle.expected_sufficiency is the expected bundle label.

candidate_exact_agreement.rationale: baseline 51/66 plus at least 0.05 absolute gain

bundle_exact_agreement.rationale: non-inferiority to the ceiling baseline 60/60 with margin of one case

direct_support_false_rejection.rationale: acceptable false-rejection cost; non-DIRECT or UNKNOWN on an oracle-DIRECT_SUPPORT candidate counts as rejection; comparator baseline is 0

natural_candidate_coverage.scope: all candidates outside ambiguous_shell_command and missing_provenance categories must be non-UNKNOWN

field_error_rate.scope: validation errors over 66 candidate decisions plus 60 bundle decisions

pass_rule: ALL gates must pass. Any failed gate archives the candidate scorer under the Step 4 branch exit: no scorer enters Step 6 and the paper continues on the validated deterministic/base system.
